settings_tabs._note: Base ThemeSettingsPage tab → settings-key map, mirrored from the controller's baseTabKeys. A theme.config.js settingsSchema may APPEND keys/tabs; the checker uses this to reject a key that a theme puts in a different tab than the base does (save/reset are per-tab, so that would be ambiguous).
